facts.value: While on STEM OPT, you are required to do reporting every 6 months to maintain your F-1 status.
Submit the 6-month reporting eForm to confirm that your employment information is up to date.
Submit the 12-month reporting eForm to confirm that your employment information is up to date AND upload the I-983 Pg. 5 Self-Evaluation.
Submit the 18-month reporting eForm to confirm that your employment information is up to date.
Submit the 24-month reporting eForm to confirm that your employment information is up to date AND upload the I-983 Pg. 5 Final Evaluation.
You can submit each report up to 30 days before your 6-month deadline.
Do not call or email the office for reporting; submit through the MyISSC eForm portal.
For more details on the reporting requirements, refer to the STEM OPT Validation Reporting Homebase Course.
